title: bug: Immich Integration show as working, zero results.
body: ### Describe the bug The Immich integration's connection test succeeds, and asset-level calls work, but any album-related call (getAlbumsAsync / getAlbumAsync) fails with a 401 Unauthorized. This breaks the Immich Album Carousel widget entirely: the Album dropdown never populates with real albums (only shows the "All photos" default), and selecting/clearing the album field has no effect since there's nothing else to pick. Verified this is not an Immich-side, API-key, or permissions issue — see reproduction below. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Add an Immich integration in Homarr (URL: http://:2283, no trailing slash). 2. Generate an Immich API key with full permissions (tested with all scopes enabled, including album.read, album.share, album.download). 3. Test the connection in Homarr — succeeds. 4. Add an "Immich Album Carousel" widget pointed at the integration. 5. Open the widget's Album dropdown — only "All photos" is listed, despite the Immich instance having 3 real albums. 6. Widget shows "no integration data available." 7. Container logs show: caused by Error: Error: 401 status="401" at Object.tt [as ok] (.../chunks/_1-dl6ca._.js:1:28499) ... at async h.getAlbumsAsync (.../chunks/_1-dl6ca._.js:37:93200) (Same 401 occurs on getAlbumAsync when a specific album/"All photos" is selected and the widget tries to fetch photos.) Confirms this is not an auth/permissions problem: Using the exact same API key stored in the Homarr integration, direct curl calls succeed: bash curl -H "x-api-key: " -H "Accept: application/json" "http://:2283/api/server/ping" # {"res":"pong"} curl -H "x-api-key: " -H "Accept: application/json" "http://:2283/api/albums" # Returns all 3 albums with full metadata, 200 OK Re-pasting/re-saving the API key in the Homarr integration and retesting did not change the behavior — connection test still reports success, album calls still 401. ### Impact No large impact besides Immich object on board displays: No Integration data available ### Additional information Asset-level integration test (/api/server/ping equivalent) passes. All Immich API key permission scopes were enabled (Asset, Album, AlbumAsset, AlbumUser, Server, etc.) with no change in behavior — ruling out a scope issue. Suspect the album-list/album-detail requests Homarr sends may differ from the asset/ping requests in headers or method in a way Immich v3.1.0 rejects, but I don't have visibility into the exact outgoing request from the Homarr side. ### Version 1.76.0 ### Installation method Docker Run ### Browser Safari
